decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated a mix of high-end portable speakers, budget waterproof options, and premium bookshelf systems. The consideration set includes top-tier brands like JBL and Bose alongside well-reviewed aesthetic and value picks. I ultimately chose the JBL Charge 5 because it has an industry-leading 4.8 rating across more than 16,000 reviews, indicating consistent quality and performance. Its IP67 waterproof rating and 20-hour battery life make it the most versatile and reliable option for a portable Bluetooth speaker compared to the Bose SoundLink Color II or the budget EDUPLINK.
